decode_mode.reason: This broad decode mode reproduces the previously validated LLVM conservative 524873-slot graph and is used only as a decoding aid; it is not a claim about retail hardware ISA extensions.

historical_intermediate_reference.note: This September 21 adr-coverage count predates Recovery F/G/J and remains a comparison reference, not a final Recovery J identity.

claim_boundary: The LLVM recovery tree now contains zero explicit unknown/unsupported words and fully builds, but it is still not claimed equivalent to Recovery J. Runtime-dependent virtual calls and the canonical Capstone/title-inventory fixed point remain unrecovered.

changes: Preserve condition-failed fallthrough for predicated indirect PC writes and branches.
Recover old-style ARM call continuations that set LR explicitly before a register-indirect branch.
Recover three already-reached base-relative switch tables using the pinned frontend's add-pc/base/offset pattern.
Recognize direct-call inline-word thunks whose callee begins with post-index LDR from LR; skip the inline data word and resume at pc+8.
Exclude aligned null-terminated ASCII string words and proven absolute/base-relative switch-table words from traversal.
Route vldmia/vstmia plus scalar vmls/vnmls forms to the existing restored VFP backends.

historical_intermediate_delta.note: These are comparison deltas only. The September 21 counts predate Recovery F/G/J and are not being used as a target to tune toward.

relative_pointer_table_experiment.detail: A one-pass preserved self-relative-table rule identifies 22 candidate tables / 296 words. With the LLVM compatibility graph it reaches 552048 slots, so it remains diagnostic-only rather than being forced into the production recovery graph.
